label: State Secret

szenen.text: Congress had a *secret bunker.* It sat under a luxury hotel.
The Greenbrier resort in West Virginia hid it for *decades.*
Project Greek Island began in the late *1950s.*
Cost: about *$14 million.* It was meant to survive nuclear war.
Lawmakers were to hide here if the Soviets attacked.
Workers posed as hotel technicians to keep the *cover.*
The government shut it down almost *immediately.*
Today you can tour it. What else is *still hidden?*

caption: For decades, Congress had a nuclear bunker hidden beneath a hotel. Then a newspaper told the world. What other secrets are still out there? AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
